post.description:
Preview: available only to Organizations admitted to the Agent preview; others receive 403 agent_preview_not_enabled. This surface may change or be removed. An Agent is a named preset of Session creation settings owned by one active End User. The AgentTemplate must currently be selectable.

Authorization: OrganizationApiKey; persisted credentials determine Organization and End User scope.

201.description: The created Agent. Repeating the key and body returns the Agent that key created, in its current state.

ETag.description: Opaque Agent revision token for If-Match.

400.description: The body or Idempotency-Key is invalid.

401.description: A current Organization API Key is required.

403.description: auth_kind_forbidden: an Organization API Key is required; agent_preview_not_enabled: the Organization is not admitted to the Agent preview.

404.description: agent_not_found: the active ordinary End User is unavailable; agent_template_unavailable: the AgentTemplate is not selectable.

409.description: idempotency_key_reused: the key was used with another body.

patch.description:
Preview: available only to Organizations admitted to the Agent preview; others receive 403 agent_preview_not_enabled. This surface may change or be removed. Omitted fields keep their value; `sessionDefaults`, when present, replaces the stored defaults as a whole, so send them complete. Changes apply to Sessions created afterwards; existing Sessions keep their configuration. A changed AgentTemplate must currently be selectable.

Authorization: OrganizationApiKey; persisted credentials determine Organization and End User scope.

ETag.description: Opaque Agent revision token for If-Match.

401.description: A current Organization API Key is required.

403.description: auth_kind_forbidden: an Organization API Key is required; agent_preview_not_enabled: the Organization is not admitted to the Agent preview.

post.description:
Preview: available only to Organizations admitted to the Agent preview; others receive 403 agent_preview_not_enabled. This surface may change or be removed. Resolves the Agent's Session defaults with this request's model, Realtime Model, Billing Tag and Client Tools, and creates an ordinary Session with them. The Idempotency-Key shares the namespace of ordinary Session creation: a retry returns the original Session even after the Agent changed, and repeating ordinary Session creation with the same key and the resolved body returns the same Session. Session creation refusals pass through unchanged and leave the key reusable.

Authorization: OrganizationApiKey; persisted credentials determine Organization and End User scope.

201.description: The created Session and the Agent it was created through.

ETag.description: The Session model ETag, as returned by ordinary Session creation.

400.description: validation_error: the body or Idempotency-Key is invalid, or the Agent Session defaults are no longer accepted by Session creation.

401.description: A current Organization API Key is required.

403.description: auth_kind_forbidden: an Organization API Key is required; agent_preview_not_enabled: the Organization is not admitted to the Agent preview.

404.description: agent_not_found: the active ordinary End User or the Agent is unavailable; Session creation not-found refusals such as agent_template_unavailable pass through.

409.description: session_creation_conflict: the key was used for another Agent, other choices or another Session creation; other Session creation conflicts pass through.

503.description: Session creation dependencies are temporarily unavailable.
